verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of incremental rollout features like canary deployments, rolling deploys with health checks, or blue-green strategies; it focuses on Sprites/AI-agent VM features and general platform reliability complaints unrelated to deploy-workflow controls. Missing for 10: any mention of rolling/canary deploy strategy, staged rollout percentages, health-check gating, or rollback-on-failure automation during deploys.
